caveats: Offline fallback uses a synthetic Story County climate series; it is not an observed NASA record.
POWER is gridded/reanalysis weather for the field center, not a sensor in the field.
No NASA observations feed this saved result. The listed products are not inputs to the synthetic example.
SMAP pixels cover about 9 km. Even when added, they cannot show moisture differences within a field.
Crop prices, local rules, disease, soil tests, planting dates and equipment still need local review.
